subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood runtime + GreenByte infra — reschedule?
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.ai>

Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio.alvarez@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Subject: Technical deep-dive: Redwood runtime + GreenByte infra — reschedule?

Hi Elena / Luke —

Thanks again for the time last week. Per our conversation we scheduled a 45-min technical deep-dive to review integration points between your inference pipeline and the Redwood runtime. Please find a draft agenda attached (Redwood_GreenByte_TDS_agenda_v1.pdf).

Proposed window: May 22, 2027 at 10:00 AM PT / 1:00 PM ET.

Goals for the session:
- Quick pass on GreenByte infra (networking, VPC egress, firewall rules)
- Walk through the sample request flow and auth model
- Validate data handling and KV cache patterns for your workload
- Identify any blockers for a pilot deployment

Could you confirm attendees and whether we need VPN or special IP allowlisting for the demo? Sergio will own the runtime walkthrough and Jonas will cover rollout/SLAs.

If that slot doesn't work, here are a couple alternates in Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood/tds-30m

Thanks,
Rachel
Rachel Kim
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
Email: rachel.kim@redwood.ai
Mobile: +1 (415) 555-0199

Hi Rachel —

Thanks — 10:00 AM PT on May 22 works for us. I'll bring Luke (platform lead) and maybe our SRE, depending on availability. We do require a short IP allowlist for the demo environment; I'll share the CIDR range once I confirm with infra.

Couple notes before the call:
- We'll want to see auth flow for API keys and any proxy behavior
- Can you include a quick section on preferred quantization/latency tradeoffs?

I'll follow up with the allowlist and the SRE name later today. Looking forward to it.

Best,

Head of Product | GreenByte Solutions
elena@greenbyte.io

Elena / Luke —

I joined the Zoom at 10:00 AM PT and the conference room was empty — I waited ~15 minutes and tried the dial-in as well. Sergio and Jonas are on the line (I've left a brief screen share ready). No sign of GreenByte attendees on Zoom or in the calendar event.

If you were blocked by the allowlist or last-minute ops incident, no problem — I wanted to check in before I closed the meeting. Key things we were prepared to demo:
- Live request/response latency at different batching levels
- KV cache behavior for short-lived sessions
- A sample fallback policy (cheaper quantized variant)

I'll hold off on posting the recording publicly, but I can share the short capture and the slide deck internally. Can we pick a new 30–45 min window this week? If your infra team needs an IP for our demo host, please send it over and we can do a quick smoke test before the call.

Thanks,
